name: Register
description: Printer’s registration marks — a ring crossed by hairlines, dropped on every intersection of the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { width: 58%; height: 58%; margin: 21%; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 50%; border: calc(14px / @Y) solid @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 46%; top: -34%; width: 8%; height: 168%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -34%; top: 46%; width: 168%; height: 8%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
